Subject: Handover play and QBR briefing: draft for review

Team —

I put together a brief handover / leadership note and an outline for the QBR slide pack that ties the operational moves to OKR trajectory. Goal is to (1) give managers a concise script for the org message, and (2) have a one-slide readout for the QBR that explains why we're consolidating two platform teams and how we’ll measure success over the next quarter.

What I need from you by EOD Wednesday:
- Jonas: specific operational cadence (who owns weekly runbooks, oncall shifts) + suggested comm timeline.
- Marissa: HR/people language for transitions and manager talking points (protective framing, career paths).
- Vivek: metrics we should include on the one-slide (latency, p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, deployment velocity).
- Rachel: any regulatory/compliance caveats to call out (private deployments, customer SLAs).

Attached are two files: draft-announcement-v1.docx (short memo) and qbr-slide-outline.pptx (single-slide layout). I tried to keep the memo < 250 words. Please mark edits in the doc and add comments on the slide.

I plan to circulate the finalized memo to leadership on Thu morning and then a wider org send on Friday afternoon after manager syncs. If we need an alternate cadence, flag it.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Platform Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Edits and answers inline:
- Operational cadence: recommend 2-week transition window for handover + a 6-week stabilisation checkpoint. Weekly runbook owners: assign to Platform Core (formerly Team A) for infra health, and to Serving Runtime for release cutover. I put a short table in the doc (see 'ops-roles' section).
- Oncall shifts: rotate between the two lead engineers for the first 4 weeks, then move to a single-platform oncall pool.
- Comm timeline: manager sync Thu afternoon (I can lead), leadership memo to be shared Fri 10am, wider org send Fri 4pm after manager Q&A.

I left a few comments on the memo where we should avoid naming individual contributors. Also added a suggested FAQ item for customers concerned about availability during the cutover.

Jonas

Thanks — this reads well. A few notes from People/HR:
- Framing: emphasize skill growth and opportunity — "consolidation to accelerate impact and reduce cognitive load for managers." Avoid phrases like "elimination" or "headcount reduction" unless HR is coordinating the message.
- Manager script: include bullet that managers should offer 1:1 time within 48 hours for any impacted ICs.
- Career paths: add a line pointing to internal mobility career coaching and a 30/60/90 plan template.

I've added suggested wording in the doc and attached a short FAQ snippet (people-faq.txt) as a comment. If we plan to proactively reach out to customers, HR recommends we prepare an internal list of affected projects to share with AMs only.

Marissa
